payload.body: RULE: de tim nguyen nhan wake xuyen may khong danh thuc. Phan tich ma tren main: sau fetch, apps/fgos/src/wiring/mailbox_ingest.rs goi nudge(&wake) -> nudge_remote (packages/mailbox/rust/store/src/verbs.rs:173) chi nudge khi wake.effective && to_nudge; neu outstanding (co wake truoc chua doc) thi chi tra Pending; neu version khong trong nudge.versions thi Refused(version-not-tested). Ket qua in ra stderr cua 'fgos events sync' dong 'mailbox-sync: nudge for <id>: <report>'. Lan truoc em do stderr (>/dev/null) nen mat dong do. BAY GIO: sh6w dang ranh (da tra loi xong). Hay gui them MOT thu --wake moi toi claude-sh6w@fg-server va bao em gio gui. Em dang sync moi 20 giay va ghi nguyen stderr vao file; em se bao lai chinh xac NudgeReport (Sent/Pending/Refused/khong co dong nao = wake.effective sai hoac thu bi chan truoc do) trong khoang 15 phut.
